question: Settle the unsure crag pairs (p003 p004 p036 p039 p041 p044 p047 p085 p086 p122 p155 p167) against Mountain Project's area listings.
answer: Ten pairs are DISTINCT because Mountain Project lists both rows as separate climbs on the same area page (p003, p036, p039, p041, p044, p085, p086, p122, p155, p167). p004 and p047 could not be verified: the relevant MP pages were not reachable or do not show the problems. The listings fetched are alphabetical, so left-to-right adjacency could not be checked.
recommendation: Merge nothing from the verified set; keep every row in those ten pairs. Leave p004 (Charlotte's Web / Right) and p047 (Sendy Claws / Left) unmerged as unsure until their pages can be read in a browser.

proposed.why: MP Section 2 lists two climbs both titled Unnamed 5.7 (one graded 5.7, one 5.8, sport/TR), plus Another Unnamed Route 5.8. Our rows stand for those separate climbs; no FA or description to merge on. Optionally set the second to 5.8.

Smith Rock Bouldering lists Main Smith Rock Area (19 climbs) but the problem list was not reachable; searches only found a Santa Barbara Charlotte's Web. A Right version with the same V5 grade and FA could be a separate exit or the same line; unproven.
MP Big Rail Boulder lists Big Rail (V2), Big Rail Left (V2), Big Rail Traverse (V3), Micro-Tunnel (V2-3) and T.B.M. (V2) as five separate problems.
MP Kiwanis Camp Crag lists two separate unnamed trad climbs: Unnamed 5.9 (trad/TR) and Unnamed 5.9+ (trad). Our grades match.
MP Hole/Little Wing lists Shorty Slab and Shorty Slab Left as two problems, both V-easy.
MP Section 4 has four trad climbs including an Unnamed 5.8 and an Unnamed 5.9 as separate entries; ours are 5.9 and 5.8.
No MP page found for Mystery Zone or Sendy Claws (the Phone Home Boulders pages show only Mime Games and Skeeter Eaters). A Left variant at the same grade may be a separate start; unverified.
MP Picnic Lunch Wall lists Highway 97 (sport 5.11b) and Full Highway 97 (5.11d) as separate climbs; the full version is the longer link-up with a harder finish.
MP lists Five Easy Pieces (5.13a, 5 pitches) and Five Easy Pieces (start) (5.12a, 65 ft, 7 bolts, FA Grosowsky 1992) as separate climbs, each with its own page.
MP Breakfast Cracks lists White Rabbit (T/TR 5.10) and White Rabbit Buttress (TR 5.11+) as two climbs, matching our rows.
MP Wave Boulder holds exactly two problems: Legal System (V3) and Objection (Desperate Warmup/Legal System) (V2). The alias-laden second title is odd, but MP files two climbs of different grade.
MP Riverside Crag lists five placeholder name-unknown sport routes: 5.10+, 5.11+, 5.11, 5.10 (aka tower route), 5.10d (aka upper route). Ours are the 5.10+ one and the tower route.

searched: Fetched MP area pages for each pair; MP lists were alphabetical so L>R order unavailable
Charlotte's Web and Sendy Claws: multiple searches, no Oregon MP problem pages found
FA info absent for all fetched rows except Five Easy Pieces (start)
